description: Header file defining vectorized operations and conversions for 512-bit vectors of custom 8-bit floating point types (Float8_e4m3fn and Float8_e5m2) using AVX-512 intrinsics, including conversion functions, comparison operators, and vectorized arithmetic.

classes.name: Vectorized<Float8_e4m3fn>
classes.description: Vectorized class for 64 elements of Float8_e4m3fn type, supporting load, store, comparison, and arithmetic operations.

classes.name: Vectorized<Float8_e5m2>
classes.description: Vectorized class for 64 elements of Float8_e5m2 type, supporting load, store, comparison, and arithmetic operations.

methods.name: cvtfp8e4m3_fp32
methods.description: Converts a __m128i representing 8-bit float8 e4m3 to __m512 float32 vector.

methods.name: cvtfp32_fp8e4m3
methods.description: Converts a __m512 float32 vector to 16 __m128i representing float8 e4m3.

methods.name: fp8e4m3_to_fp32_scalar
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t float8 e4m3 value to float32 scalar.

methods.name: fp32_to_fp8e4m3_scalar
methods.description: Converts a float32 scalar to uint8_t float8 e4m3 value.

methods.name: cvtfp8e5m2_fp32
methods.description: Converts a __m128i representing 8-bit float8 e5m2 to __m512 float32 vector.

methods.name: cvtfp32_fp8e5m2
methods.description: Converts a __m512 float32 vector to 16 __m128i representing float8 e5m2.

methods.name: fp8e5m2_to_fp32_scalar
methods.description: Converts a uint8_t float8 e5m2 value to float32 scalar.

methods.name: fp32_to_fp8e5m2_scalar
methods.description: Converts a float32 scalar to uint8_t float8 e5m2 value.

methods.name: Vectorizedf8
methods.description: Template class for vectorized float8 types supporting comparison operators and load/store functions.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for vectorized float8 types.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for vectorized float8 types.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Greater-than comparison for vectorized float8 types.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Greater-than-or-equal comparison for vectorized float8 types.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Less-than comparison for vectorized float8 types.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Less-than-or-equal comparison for vectorized float8 types.
